items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMxMzA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--23fc75ac0bfcb483120f6de9d3cd08590fe01e47/KC2026%20Logo.png) ## **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for Korean Championship 2026.** ## **대한민국 국적이 아닌 참가자분들께서는 Korean Championship 2026에 참가 신청을 삼가 주시기를 정중히 부탁드립니다.** Korean Championship은 대한민국에서 매년 개최되는 다수의 WCA 대회 중 가장 중요한 대회입니다. 본 대회는 대한민국 챔피언을 선발하기 위한 대회인 만큼, 챔피언 타이틀이 대한민국 국적을 가진 참가자에게 주어지기를 바랍니다. 대한민국에서 개최되는 다른 대회에는 국적과 관계없이 언제든지 참가하실 수 있습니다. 모든 종목의 결승 라운드에서는 대한민국 국적 참가자를 위해 결승 진출자 정원의 50% 또는 8명 중 적은 수가 우선 배정됩니다. 우선 배정이 적용되는 경우, 이전 라운드에서 결승에 진출할 참가자를 선정할 때 대한민국 국적 참가자를 먼저 선발하며, 이후 남은 자리는 다른 국적 참가자 중 성적이 높은 순서대로 배정됩니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2) 및 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. --- Korean Championship is the most prestigious WCA competition among all competitions held in the Republic of Korea each year. As this competition is intended to determine the national champion, we hope that the title of Korean Champion will be awarded to a competitor whose nationality is the Republic of Korea. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome to participate in other competitions held in the Republic of Korea. For the final round of every event, 50% of the finalist spots, or up to 8 spots, whichever is fewer, will be reserved for competitors whose nationality is the Republic of Korea. When these reserved spots apply, competitors whose nationality is the Republic of Korea and advance from the previous round will be selected first, followed by the highest-ranked competitors of other nationalities to fill the remaining spots. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). In accordance with WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must perform staff duties when requested by the organizers.

items.information: **Important Information for Participants:** **Location:** The competition will take place on the ground floor of the Cultural Centre. **Arrival Time:** Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering:** All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants:** If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement:** First-time participants are required to bring an original, printed, or digital copy of their official ID card. Please ensure you have this with you. **Cube Requirement:** Participants must bring their own cubes. Participants are responsible for the safety of their puzzles. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants:** If you are a citizen of a country other than India, please submit a copy of your Government-issued ID. ##### Spectators and Non-solving Participants will not be allowed within the solving area We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. **On The Spot Registration** * On-the-Spot (OTS) registration will be available for a fee of INR 1,500 if fewer than 90 competitors complete online registration. * All OTS Registrants have to come on time and follow the schedule * OTS Registrations are only available on day 1 of the competition * OTS Registration is only available from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM * OTS Registration is only available for 3x3, 2x2 and Pyraminx

items.name: Square-1 & Sides in Surrey 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ### *IMPORTANT: Please note that this is a side events competition, meaning that 3x3x3 speedsolving will not be held at this competition. First-time competitors are still very welcome to participate! However, please check the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Square1SidesinSurrey2026#competition-events) to see which events will be offered at this competition before registering.* If you are looking to compete in events that are not being held at this one, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=CA). To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). You are also welcome to join the Facebook group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). **Time Zone Reminder for U.S. Competitors: Effective November 2026, British Columbia will remain on daylight saving time year-round. As such, Vancouver will be one hour ahead of Washington state on the date of this competition. Please account for this time difference when planning your travel!** Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.
